# omni_connection (Resource)

Manages a database connection. Only `password`, `private_key`, `oauth_client_secret` and `base_role` can be changed in place; every other change replaces the connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omni_connection" "warehouse" {
  name    = "Production Snowflake"
  dialect = "snowflake"

  host      = "myaccount"
  database  = "ANALYTICS"
  warehouse = "COMPUTE_WH"
  username  = "OMNI_SVC"

  # Rotated in place: changing this does not replace the connection.
  password = var.snowflake_password

  base_role       = "QUERIER"
  include_schemas = "PUBLIC,ANALYTICS"

  query_timeout_seconds = 900
}

variable "snowflake_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dialect` (String) The database dialect.
- `name` (String) A descriptive name for the connection.

### Optional

- `accepts_license` (Boolean) Oracle only. Accept the license terms.
- `allows_user_specific_timezones` (Boolean) Whether users can set their own timezone.
- `always_scope_view_names` (Boolean) Prefix generated view names with schema and catalog.
- `authentication_type` (String) Authentication method. Dialect specific: a Snowflake connection cannot use a BigQuery method. Common values are `snowflake-password`, `snowflake-keypair`, `bigquery-service-account` and `databricks-personal-access-token`.
- `aws_role_arn` (String) Athena only. AWS role ARN to assume.
- `base_role` (String) Default role for users on this connection. One of `VIEWER`, `QUERIER`, `QUERY_TOPICS` (Restricted Querier), `MODELER`, `CONNECTION_ADMIN`, `NO_ACCESS`, or a custom role defined for your organization.
- `database` (String) Default database or catalog. For BigQuery, the project ID. For Athena, the data catalog.
- `default_schema` (String) Default schema. Required for MSSQL.
- `enable_db_semantic_layer_integration` (Boolean) Enable Snowflake semantic views or Databricks Unity Catalog integration.
- `enable_db_semantic_layer_topics` (Boolean) Snowflake and Databricks only. Enable database semantic layer topics.
- `external_oauth_audience` (String) Snowflake only. External OAuth audience.
- `external_oauth_authorization_url` (String) Snowflake only. External OAuth authorization URL.
- `external_oauth_token_url` (String) Snowflake only. External OAuth token URL.
- `host` (String) Hostname or IP of the database server. For Snowflake, the account identifier only. Not used by MotherDuck or BigQuery.
- `host_override` (String) Snowflake only. Override for the host value.
- `include_other_catalogs` (String) Comma-separated list of additional catalogs, for dialects that support multi-catalog queries.
- `include_schemas` (String) Comma-separated list of schemas to include. Empty includes all schemas.
- `infer_relationships_from_column_names` (Boolean) Infer relationships from column naming conventions during schema refresh.
- `infer_relationships_from_foreign_keys` (Boolean) Postgres and Snowflake only. Infer relationships from foreign keys.
- `max_billing_bytes` (String) BigQuery only. Maximum bytes billable for a query.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) Snowflake and Databricks only. OAuth client ID for native OAuth.
- `oauth_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Snowflake and Databricks only. OAuth client secret, sent as `oauthClientSecretUnencrypted`.
- `offloaded_schemas` (String) Comma-separated list of schemas to offload.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password to authenticate with, sent as `passwordUnencrypted`. For BigQuery, the full service account JSON. Can be rotated in place. Never returned by the API, so drift on this value is not detected.
- `port` (Number) Port for the database connection. Not used by Snowflake, MotherDuck, BigQuery, Databricks, or Athena.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Snowflake keypair authentication RSA private key, PEM format, 2048 bits or more. Can be rotated in place.
- `query_timeout_seconds` (Number) Query timeout in seconds. Maximum `3600`.
- `query_timezone` (String) Query timezone. Defaults to `NONE`.
- `region` (String) Required for BigQuery (e.g. `us`) and Athena (e.g. `us-east-1`).
- `scratch_schema` (String) Schema used for uploaded data tables.
- `system_timezone` (String) System timezone. Defaults to `UTC`.
- `trust_server_certificate` (Boolean) MSSQL, Exasol, and ClickHouse only. Trust the server certificate.
- `use_machine_auth` (Boolean) Athena and Databricks only. Use machine authentication.
- `username` (String) Username to authenticate with. For BigQuery, the service account client email.
- `warehouse` (String) Snowflake warehouse, or Databricks HTTP path.
- `wif_audience` (String) Full resource name of the workload identity pool provider, for BigQuery workload identity federation. For example `//iam.googleapis.com/projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/my-pool/providers/my-provider`.
- `wif_service_account_email` (String) Service account to impersonate for BigQuery workload identity federation. Omit to use the federated identity directly.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the connection was created.
- `id` (String) The connection's unique ID.
- `updated_at` (String) When the connection was last updated.
